title: Fix All Kit Store Kinds And Tests
description: Fix all three KitStore kinds (InMemoryKitStore, JsonFileKitStore, FolderKitStore) and their tests. Fix SketchpadStore tests. All stores are collaborative with different sync mechanisms. All tests must pass.
